digest.component_or_area: LLM eval specs / code-review concurrency overlay
propositions: The concurrency overlay lacks a standing eval spec to prevent silent regression of recall/precision behavior against a traced race-condition corpus.
A new eval spec must ground deterministic scorers (valid_findings, recall, no-fire) in minimal diff hunks distilled from production race commits, with gate at_least(2) over 3 epochs.

The spec must include at least 2 scored recall cases (unlocked twin writer, check-then-act TOCTOU) and at least 3 scored no-fire cases (lock added, atomic-write seam, deliberate probe-then-skip), each with source commit provenance.
The hard false-positive control (deliberate probe-then-skip with real lock) must be a scored passing case to establish the boundary between benign and buggy patterns.
The fail-open guard case (R3) must be present as a non-gating documented stretch (commented hunk, not scored) so it cannot fail the gate despite being known-hard for the prompt.
